# Barakat Qurtas — Independent Designer

> Independent graphic designer based in Hewlêr (Erbil), Kurdistan Region of Iraq.
> A decade of practice across design, printing and advertising — book covers,
> logos & visual identities, posters, editorial layout, photography and video.
> Available for select commissions. Replies to every serious enquiry within 48 hours.

## About
- Name: Barakat Qurtas
- Role: Independent Designer
- Location: Hewlêr (Erbil), Kurdistan Region, Iraq
- Since: 2014
- Studio: Panjamor — printing & design
- Languages of the site: English, Kurdish (Sorani), Kurmancî, Arabic, French, Turkish, Swedish

## Work
- Logos & visual identities — marks, wordmarks, a decade of drawn signs
- Book covers — typography, illustration and print composition
- Posters & editorial design
- Photography — Lightroom editing, composites, retouching
- Video & motion
- 1000+ works delivered since 2014
